mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is persistently below its long-run average for two consecutive months, market expectations for future rate hikes diminish, reducing discount rates and thereby increasing the present value of expected corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1-year average(FEDFUNDS) for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average return during the same period, or the Fed Funds Rate reverts to its long-run average within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) followed by a rapid decline in the 10-year Treasury yield (implied by FEDFUNDS) signals inflation surprise and policy tightening anticipation, which can depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 12-month moving average AND FEDFUNDS rises more than 0.25% in the following month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly worse than the 30-day rolling average during the same window, or the CPIAUCSL reverts before the FEDFUNDS peak.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) accompanied by rising consumer confidence (HOUST) creates expectations of stronger economic growth, which elevates equity risk premia and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS grows month-over-month for three consecutive months AND HOUST rises above 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative despite the labor indicators' persistence, or the effect disappears after controlling for lagged SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) accompanied by a decline in consumer demand proxies (GDPC1, RSAFS) indicates weakening economic momentum, which reduces growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls more than 5% from previous month AND GDPC1 < 12-month moving average AND RSAFS falls more than 10% from previous month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the prior 20-day average during similar contraction episodes.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4% (implied by UNRATE) and consumer spending accelerates (HOUST), it signals a strong labor market and robust demand, which elevates equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days under an expansionary regime.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% AND HOUST grows more than 3% from previous month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the 30-day average during analogous strong-demand episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) accompanied by a sustained decline in the 2-year Treasury yield (implied by FEDFUNDS) suggests that the Fed is likely to hold rates steady, lowering real borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, which can produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 2-year average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 70% of such regimes over the past decade.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden, sharp drop in labor market participation (PAYEMS) coinciding with a sharp rise in jobless claims (not available in this catalog; fallback: use UNRATE spike downward) suggests labor market weakness, which can depress sentiment and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls more than 8% from previous month AND UNRATE rises above 6% in the following week
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly worse than the prior 5-day average during comparable cooling episodes.

mechanism_narrative: During a sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) without a corresponding decline in consumer demand proxies (GDPC1, HOUST), market interprets supply-side shock as more persistent, which lowers growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls more than 10% from previous quarter AND GDPC1 > 12-month moving average AND HOUST flat or declining
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not persistently negative across multiple supply disruption events in the data.
